title: US business schools are racing to prepare students to become chief AI officers, even as companies are still figuring out what the newest C-suite role entails (Rthvika Suvarna/Bloomberg)
summary: Rthvika Suvarna / Bloomberg: US business schools are racing to prepare students to become chief AI officers, even as companies are still figuring out what the newest C-suite role entails — Business schools are racing to prepare executives for the newest C-suite role, even as companies are still figuring out what the job entails.
